_doc: Ar-Ge GDD rev 1.4+ §4 — the twenty research nodes. The ID / FAMILY / PLACE spine is NOT here: it lives in ResearchSeam.NODES as a compile-time const, because ProductLines._validate_step reads it at ITS OWN load and a file-loaded spine would make the line validator depend on I/O ordering between two lazily-loaded statics that nothing sequences. This file carries the tunable half (§13 calibration surface) and the hidden lines. ResearchTree validates every row against the seam at load and fails loudly.
_stars: §5.2 + director ruling R1 (2026-08-25): the ladder is root 1 star, branch 2 stars, continuation 2+2. §4 tables carried no requirement column; every worked example showed 2, but a 2-star root would cost a third of the founder six onboarding points just to open a family. Star N = raw >= 2N (Ürün §12.6).
_cross: §3 — exactly four cross-family links, all on the continuation-B node (the continuation whose parent is branch B). Roots and branches NEVER carry one. §3.1 sapma tavanı is enforced as: the target is in another family, is a root, costs <= 50 effort and no cash — so the worst detour is one cheap research.
_areas: §5.2 — root and branch want the family own area; continuation wants two, its own first. Family to area: capability=product, platform=engineering, practice=qa, design=design.
_hidden_doc: §4.5 — four lines the catalog never shows. Only KENDI KENDINE SERVIS is authored for the demo (§12.1, §13.5): it was lowered to the test_automation BRANCH so the new-feature-line moment is lived once. The other three keep an empty raw and are NEVER registered — director ruling R4: the node stays visible and startable, its unlock line pre-announces Erken Erisim icerigi so the player knows before spending the effort, it completes normally and its id is recorded in mvp_hidden_lines for a future EA build, but NOTHING enters the catalog and the discovery card does not claim a line opened. Blocking the node would break §3.1 (nothing telegraphed is unreachable); completing it silently empty would be an unwarned loss.
_hidden_k3_doc: The demo line own K3 must carry a research node and that node must be root-or-branch — ProductLines._validate_step 303-310 refuses otherwise, and register_runtime_line routes through the same validator. §4.5 never named one. Director ruling R7: design_system, a ROOT. With semantic_index the top rung would sit four researches deep (root, branch, root, branch), an entire demo run spent on one line.
